notes.title: Full Release Date
notes.notes:
[h2]Release Date[/h2]

Liminality is releasing [spoiler]this month (day specified below)!![/spoiler]

New information, as well as a [url=https://games.lory.dev/games/liminality/changelog]changelog[/url] and the full day of when it is releasing is available on [url=https://games.lory.dev/games/liminality]the website[/url].

TL;DR:
[list]
[*] Fixes
[*] Chapters 4, 5, 6, and 7
[*] Endings 1, 2 and 3 (in consecutive order, each one will require the one before it to be completed)
[*] (short) Prologue
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.13.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Hotfix 0.13.1[/h3]

Full changelog in-game.

Employee Hotel post processing and texturing issue has been fully fixed, as well as the softlock upon pausing while viewing an instruction manual page.

In case any more issues are encountered, you are free to report them.

notes.title: Chapter 3 (Update 0.13)
notes.notes:
[h1]Chapter 3[/h1]
[h2]Update 0.13[/h2]

Update 0.13 is finally out and a new Chapter for Liminality's lore has been added.

An item store and playtime rewards have also been added for the people who want to showcase their Steam economy items on their profile.

There are of course some issues that will be fixed in the upcoming 0.13.1 that will be released in the next few days.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Removed Spooky decorations and Spooktober event :(
[*] Added Steam item store
[*] Added Chapter 3
[*] Known issue: Employee Hotel has a buggy texture, this will be fixed in 0.13.1.
[/list]

notes.title: Spooktober Update - v0.12
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 0.12[/h2]
spookyy
[list]
[*] Added spooky decorations
[*] Fixed some bugs
[*] Spooktober event
[*] New item: Jack-O-Lantern
[*] Items now spawn properly and there's a max equipped item limit of 3
[*] Fixed the bug where you drowned out of water occasionally
[*] Fixed the bug where if you drowned the oxygen bar wouldn't show up again and you'd be immortal
[/list]

I apologize personally to the people affected by the last 2 bugs. It's been a total mistake on my part.

notes.title: Swimming Update - v0.11
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 0.11[/h2]
I am very sorry for the delay, the update is finally out.
[list]
[*] Added Swimming
[*] New event: Storm
[*] Added Photo Mode (Press N ingame)
[*] You can now choose wether you want to enable random events
directly in the menu
[*] Chapter 3 added for testers and for Discord server members upon request
[*] VHS effect blur has been removed
[/list]

notes.title: Bloodmoon Update - v0.10
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 0.10[/h2]
This is the first update since Early Access.
[list]
[*] [b]Added Bloodmoon[/b] (you need to turn on Random Events in the Chapter 1 menu at the bottom right)
[*] Fixed some bugs
[*] Added a Changelog: you can find it under the "Extras" menu
[*] Optimized the game to run a bit better on older GPUs (the minimum system requirements have not changed)
[/list]
